comment: Solar wind parameters have started to increase over the past hours likely due to the onset of fast solar wind from a southern coronal hole (CH). As conditions are still increasing there is a chance of some STORM G1 intervals on day one. Geomagnetic activity is anticipated to decline in the second forecast window as CH effects wane, though there remains a possibility of ACTIVE spells. In the third period, there may be a transition into a high-speed stream from a northern negative polarity CH. This is expected to be less geoeffective at this time of year due to the polarity but there may still be some enhancement in conditions.
role: independent advisory; score_effect=0 until prospective validation
